FN-WC8TEE5-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 14
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 14 as introduced could increase the obligations of state, counties and municipalities,
and their respective law enforcement agencies, by an undetermined amount, to comply with the
provisions of this bill regarding litigation in circuit court when the release of a body-worn
camera recording is denied by a law enforcement agency. The obligations of law enforcement
agencies could be offset, partly by the fee charged and collected for the production of a
recording as provided by this bill.
